what: Decision: exclude .aide/memories/ from grep by default via .ignore file (ripgrep respects .ignore). Keeps memories in git (shared) but forces structured access via aide_recall/aide_search. Prevents grep from bypassing ranking, scoping, dedup, and recalled_count tracking. Configurable: users can opt in to include memories in search. Default = exclude.
why: Validation showed grep returning raw memory JSON mixed with code results. Agent saw memory content without going through recall flow, bypassing all structured access.
